about_the_game: Experience co-op action in [b]Varthos - Heir to the Throne[/b], a rogue-lite game set in a procedurally generated world! Battle hordes of monsters, discover weapons with random skills, and combine your team's abilities strategically. Through smart teamwork you can claim the throne and fulfill your destiny!

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work. This content may include: Frequent Violence or Gore, Some Nudity, General Mature Content

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel CPU 8th Gen 8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 2700
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 Super / AMD 6600 XT, with at least of 6GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Best experienced on a SSD drive
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel CPU 10th Gen 10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD Radeon RX 6800, with at least of 8GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Best experienced on a M.2 SSD drive
